author: Kif Leswing
title: Apple just released a new product that goes under your sheets and tracks your sleep - and it reveals a major strategy for the iPhone giant (AAPL)
text: Apple just released a new product that goes under your sheets and tracks your sleep — and it reveals a major strategy for the iPhone giant (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Dec 7, 2018, 1:55 pm 33 pts Apple has released Beddit Sleep Monitor 3.5, a sleep tracker that goes on top of your mattress and under your sheets. It's a way to track sleep quality without having to wear an Apple Watch, which requires nightly charging. It's a new version of a product made by a startup that Apple bought last…
